YOUTUBE PLAYABLE TEMPLATE, COMMON RULES. First script in index.html: <script src="https://www.youtube.com/game_api/v1"></script>. Wrap ytgame in a platform module with stubs so it runs without the SDK: firstFrameReady after first frame, gameReady once when Title accepts input, sendScore({value:int}) on Result, loadData/saveData JSON {"v":1,"best":0,"runs":0,"progress":{}}, onPause = freeze + silence + save, onResume = stay Paused, isAudioEnabled/onAudioEnabledChange drive master gain (no mute button), errors -> health.logError. No network, fonts, images, audio files, localStorage. All values in game_spec.json (stage units, seconds, palette tokens). Canvas fills window, stage 720x1280 fit contain, DPR cap 2, works 9:32 to 32:9, HUD anchored to screen edges + safe area: score top-left, timer top-center, pause top-right. Fixed 1/60 step, pools, no allocation in loop. States BOOT, TITLE, PLAY, PAUSED, RESULT. Input = actions from keys AND Pointer Events (tap, hold, swipe, drag, zones, joystick), same actions on keyboard and touch, buttons reachable by Enter/Space and Escape/P, touch-action none. Flat primitives, palette bg #121318 surface #1E2028 line #343846 text #F4F5F7 player #4CC9F0 hazard #F25F5C pickup #FFD166 positive #06D6A0 special #B388FF neutral #7D8597, system-ui font. Synth Web Audio sfx: uiTap start collect hit destroy action powerup win lose. Modules: spec platform viewport input audio save pool draw ui game world systems skins (skins read only look).

GAME: GRID & MATCH (match-3 skeleton, primitives only). Portrait stage 720x1280 fit contain. Swap neighbouring tiles to line up 3+ of a type. Put in game_spec.json (genre part; more next prompt):
{"meta":{"id":"grid-match","title":"Grid & Match","version":"0.1.0","archetype":"grid-match","scoreLabel":"Score"},"input":{"bindings":{"up":{"keys":["ArrowUp","KeyW"],"pointer":"cellSwipeUp"},"down":{"keys":["ArrowDown","KeyS"],"pointer":"cellSwipeDown"},"left":{"keys":["ArrowLeft","KeyA"],"pointer":"cellSwipeLeft"},"right":{"keys":["ArrowRight","KeyD"],"pointer":"cellSwipeRight"},"select":{"keys":["Space","Enter"],"pointer":"cellTap"}}},"board":{"maxWidth":660,"maxHeight":820,"centerY":700,"cellGap":6,"tileScale":0.78,"swapDuration":0.15,"clearDuration":0.2,"fallCellDuration":0.06,"cascadePause":0.08,"levelClearDelay":1.2},"entities":[{"id":"t1","kind":"tile","look":{"shape":"circle","color":"player","size":1}},{"id":"t2","kind":"tile","look":{"shape":"diamond","color":"pickup","size":1}},{"id":"t3","kind":"tile","look":{"shape":"triangle","color":"positive","size":1}},{"id":"t4","kind":"tile","look":{"shape":"hexagon","color":"special","size":1}},{"id":"t5","kind":"tile","look":{"shape":"roundRect","color":"neutral","size":1}},{"id":"t6","kind":"tile","look":{"shape":"ring","color":"text","size":1}},{"id":"lineClear","kind":"bonus","effect":"line","look":{"shape":"rect","color":"text","size":0.25}},{"id":"bomb","kind":"bonus","effect":"area","radius":1,"look":{"shape":"ring","color":"text","size":0.5}},{"id":"colorBomb","kind":"bonus","effect":"color","look":{"shape":"hexagon","color":"text","size":1}},{"id":"cover","kind":"cover","symbol":"c","layers":1,"look":{"shape":"roundRect","color":"surface","size":1}},{"id":"cover2","kind":"cover","symbol":"C","layers":2,"look":{"shape":"roundRect","color":"line","size":1}}]}

BOARD
For now one level: 7 cols x 8 rows, 5 tile types (the first 5 entities of kind "tile"), 20 moves, minMatch 3, 20 points per tile. cellSize = min((maxWidth-(cols-1)*cellGap)/cols, (maxHeight-(rows-1)*cellGap)/rows), board centered at x 360, y board.centerY, row 0 on top. Cells drawn as surface rounded squares, pre-rendered. Tiles drawn at cellSize*tileScale*look.size (look.size is a ratio of the cell for board pieces). Grid in flat typed arrays (type, bonus, cover per cell, -1 = empty).
Generation: fill cell by cell, never picking a type that makes a run of minMatch with placed tiles; regenerate if no valid move exists.

INPUT (same result on every input)
Keyboard: arrows/WASD move a cursor (player-colored ring); Space/Enter selects the tile; with a tile selected, an arrow swaps it with that neighbour. Pointer: cellTap = tap on a cell (select; a second tap on a neighbour swaps; same tile deselects; other tile moves the selection); cellSwipeLeft/Right/Up/Down = swipe starting on a cell, swaps with that neighbour as soon as the swipe threshold is crossed. Mouse drag works like a swipe. Pointer presses also move the cursor. Presses off the board are ignored.

TURNS
Player turn (IDLE, input on) then system turn (input locked, select/swap presses dropped, cursor still moves):
SWAPPING (swapDuration) -> CHECK -> no match: REVERTING (swapDuration, no move spent) -> IDLE. Match: one move spent -> CLEARING (clearDuration) -> FALLING (fallCellDuration per cell) -> CASCADE_CHECK (cascadePause) -> CLEARING again if new matches, else SETTLE -> IDLE.
Match detection: scan rows and columns for runs >= minMatch of the same type; overlapping runs form one group. Each cleared tile scores 20 points.
Gravity: in each column tiles fall down to fill empty cells; new random tiles enter from above the board and fall in.
Moves reach 0 at SETTLE -> RESULT (lose). sendScore(floor(score)).

Skins: drawTile per tile type reading only look (shape + color tell types apart; shape alone must be enough). Systems in this order: input, turn, match, clear, gravity, goal, fx. Check a full game with keyboard only, touch only, mouse only.
